name: CIMB Group Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年CIMB Group的公告主要涉及股息派发、长期激励计划下的新股发行以及董事会委员会成员变动，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约信息。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比微降0.4%，净利润同比增长2.6%。
overview_en: In 2026, CIMB Group's announcements mainly covered dividend payments, new share issuances under the long-term incentive plan, and changes in board committee memberships, with no disclosed expansion, reduction, divestment, or new contracts in any business segment. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue declined 0.4% year-on-year while net profit rose 2.6% year-on-year.
